label: sec:step-algebraic
html: Algebraic step. To turn the categorical action into a computable knot invariant, we pass from braids to a trace-carrying quotient. The braid group B_n acts on A^{\otimes n}. The quotient by the Hecke relation (\sigma_i - q)(\sigma_i + q^{-1}) = 0 is the Iwahori–Hecke algebra H_n(q). This algebra controls the combinatorics of the categorical action. The Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M packages braid words into a class function. Evaluation on \beta_K yields the Jones polynomial J_K(q) = \mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta_K)). We develop braids, knot groups, the Hecke algebra, and the Skein-relation translation.
